breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: World Cup fans are missing games after their resale tickets fall through
breaking_news.summary: The ordeal has left fans forced to either miss out on a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity or scramble to find new tickets, often costing more and for worse seats.

breaking_news.headline: This mindset shift can help you get better at using up your leftovers
breaking_news.summary: Don't let your leftovers go to waste. Cookbook authors share clever storage techniques — like an "Eat Me First" box in your fridge — and cooking tricks to help you make the most of your food scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Red, white and glowing blue: Trump's push for new reactors reaches the finish line
breaking_news.summary: A program initiated by the Trump administration has allowed small companies to rush their testing of several new nuclear reactor designs. Some worry that safety is being compromised.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court cements Trump's power over agencies long considered independent
breaking_news.summary: In a 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court struck down a 91-year-old precedent that has prevented presidents from removing members of independent agencies meant to be a check on his power.

breaking_news.headline: Computer scientist on why he believes mass layoffs due to AI is a 'convenient excuse'
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Princeton computer scientist Sayash Kapoor about his assertions that AI won't lead to mass layoffs.

breaking_news.headline: Tricks to help you spend less money at restaurants
breaking_news.summary: Personal finance and nutrition experts share simple strategies that make it possible to eat out without spending a fortune. One tip? You might have to let go of your fast food delivery habit.

breaking_news.headline: Meta considered buying Kalshi before developing its own prediction market app
breaking_news.summary: Mark Zuckerberg met with Kalshi's CEO last year about a potential deal, but talks did not move forward. Now Meta is making its own prediction market app.

breaking_news.headline: US Supreme Court upholds bans on transgender women in female school and college sports
breaking_news.summary: Trump called it a "big win" but a major LGBT campaign group described the ruling as "heartbreaking".

breaking_news.headline: Firefighters struggle to contain deadly Greek wildfire
breaking_news.summary: More than 100 firefighters are fighting a fire near Thessaloniki which has claimed at least two lives.

breaking_news.headline: 'Absolute madness': Row over plan to demolish Nazi bunker under Berlin
breaking_news.summary: City officials want to build flats on the city centre site but others say it should be preserved as part of Germany's history.

breaking_news.headline: What are US and Japanese soldiers doing in the middle of the Australian bush?
breaking_news.summary: The BBC's Katy Watson explains why troops are training in remote Australia - a country not at war, thousands of kilometres from today's major conflicts.

breaking_news.headline: Roof collapse kills 14 children at Pakistan tuition centre
breaking_news.summary: Two people are taken into custody after the incident in the Kahna suburb of Lahore.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court's birthright ruling is major blow to Trump
breaking_news.summary: The BBC’s Gary O’Donoghue explains what the court's landmark ruling means for the US president.

breaking_news.headline: Americans react to Supreme Court upholding birthright citizenship
breaking_news.summary: The BBC asked Americans how they felt after the Supreme Court's ruling on citizenship for babies born in the US.

breaking_news.headline: India's biggest share sales tell the story of a country glued to its phones
breaking_news.summary: NSE and Jio Platforms embody the sweeping changes in how India has consumed, invested and transacted over the past decade.

breaking_news.headline: Shetland backs plan to connect islands with £1.5bn undersea tunnels
breaking_news.summary: The undersea links between some of the UK's most northerly islands could be in place within eight years.

breaking_news.headline: Hollywood director gets two and a half years in prison for defrauding Netflix
breaking_news.summary: He was accused of using money for a Netflix show on lavish purchases like Rolls Royces and Ferraris.

breaking_news.headline: Chinese tycoon sentenced to 30 years in US jail
breaking_news.summary: Guo Wengui branded himself as a China critic, gaining followers who backed his fraudulent schemes.

breaking_news.headline: We had packed lunches every day for 10 years and retired at 40
breaking_news.summary: The Fire (Financially Independent, Retire Early) movement sees followers save as much as possible.
